coordinate_evidence._encoder_loss_signals: The listed 0x2040 absolute_feedback subentries expose positions only; no encoder-loss validity signal is available in this readback. In both evidence modes, statusword 0x6041 fault bit 3 and any nonzero error code 0x603F make readiness faulted without themselves invalidating coordinates or Home. The encoder-specific error code 0x7305 additionally invalidates coordinates and Home (GradientOS docs/resources/a6ec_manual_codes.md, A6-EC fault table: Encoder error). PDO discontinuity and contradictory encoder evidence still invalidate independently.

coordinate_evidence._source: The nine-motor bench's servo host, 2026-09-13 fixedpdo-17080976.log and registers-1.log: 0x2040:2B/2D rotation-frame signed64, 0x6064 modulo W. High/low/high bracket rejects low-word tearing before binding; no :29 read. Raw :21/:23 diagnostics have a different scale.

coordinate_evidence._acquisition_unverified: The nine-motor bench's servo host, sampled-412be4dd.log, 2026-09-13: measured two-upload acquisitions 56000000..83094896 ns (about 83 ms), uploads 24000000..44000000 ns, 0.60..0.67 samples/s/axis. Unverified bracketed acquisition_max = ceil((83094896 + 44000000)/1000000)*1000000 = 128000000 ns. Required age >= interval + N * acquisition_max + diagnostics + margin: 3000000000 = 1500000000 + 9 * 128000000 + 44000000 + 304000000 ns. Diagnostics and arbitration allocations remain unverified under contention. Checkpointed foreign uploads are outside this baseline sum: native-home truth refresh adds up to 9 * 44000000 ns, and startup and mapping readbacks can each insert an upload between sample opportunities. A refresh burst reaches 1500000000 + 9 * 128000000 + 9 * 44000000 + 44000000 = 3092000000 ns before margin; grace covers the resulting transient inhibit for idle axes without a fault if coherent recovery arrives within the bound. start_gap_ns and maximum_start_gap_ns publish sampling pauses. PDO history has ceil(age/cycle)+2 entries; PDO age remains one cycle. Missing, Unavailable, Cadence and Torn publications cannot replace retained valid evidence or renew its age. Sound Cadence/Stale samples with retained PDO history and bounded low-word skew are checked for contradictions in the receiving cycle. For multi_turn only, after age expiry inhibit the affected axis with coordinate_invalid readiness and preserve Home for two sample cadences = 3000000000 ns; coherent recovery restores idle-axis readiness, longer absence or contradictory evidence latches the coordinate fault and requires rehome. Grace writes controlword 0; a moving axis fails closed with FaultDriveReadiness next cycle when the drive leaves enabled. Qualify bracket acquisitions, gaps and recovery on all nine axes.
